lessons: Keep educational and science episodes concise and visually stimulating, as demonstrated by the strong retention on learning content.
Avoid overly long compilation videos or low-pacing mythologies if retention drops to zero early on.
Start mythological and historical stories directly with the core conflict rather than slow exposition to reduce early drop-offs.
Utilize relatable characters like Gopal Bhar or children in mysteries to maintain viewer engagement past the introduction.
Keep overall narrative arcs tightly edited to prevent audience fatigue in the middle chapters.
titles: Titles featuring direct questions or urgent mysteries (e.g., about footprints or glowing objects) secure higher initial clicks.
Using Title B variants that emphasize character action and curiosity generally outperform passive descriptive titles.
Adding relevant emojis helps visually anchor the theme and improves click-through rates on mobile feeds.
